after.label: Intermediate Capture
after.evidence: Bxe6 makes the near-equal exchange before Qxc1. Every legal answer preserves the follow-up exchange. Playing Qxc1 first instead permits Bxd5 by the piece removed on e6. Both orders are checked against all legal replies, including counterchecks and immediate off-square captures. From this position the bounded local material retention is at least 230 centipawns, compared with at most 0 after that reversed-order recovery: a move-order improvement of at least 230 centipawns. This is not a forced reply, free bishop, or whole-position evaluation. This completes the exchange begun by Bxc1, not a fresh material win. The earlier loss is 500 centipawns; including it gives a local recovery bound of -270 centipawns. The move-order advantage does not erase that debt.
